title: Feature request (for discussion) add negative Carbs input
symptom: Sometimes carb absorption can be much faster than calculated COB with deviation, leading to overestimation of remaining COB and overcorrection on BG variation. Users may not enter carbs during exercise to avoid overcorrection, and there is no easy way to reduce remaining COB.
evidence_quote: The idea is to allow negative carbs entry (max allowed value is remaing COB), to reduce remaining COB.
